scientific_question: Does calibration-only selective promotion of the source-symmetric sequential EOG contextual representation improve untouched real ecological prediction relative to a frozen conventional baseline?

physical_response_separation.site_documentation: R/sites.R and man/sites.Rd document site_id, site name/region and latitude/longitude as site information
physical_response_separation.response_documentation: R/penguin_obs.R, man/penguin_obs.Rd and README document penguin_obs as counts and presence/absence observations, keyed by site_id and species_id with year/date fields

focal_taxon.independent_inclusion_evidence: Package README/example and documentation show ADPE observations in penguin_obs; APBP description identifies Adelie among database species

published_response_semantics.eligible_response_rule: rows for ADPE with nonmissing integer year and presence in {0,1}
published_response_semantics.binary_response_rule: presence as published; no pseudoabsence construction
published_response_semantics.duplicate_site_year_rule: if multiple eligible ADPE rows occur for one site-year, y=1 if any published presence==1, y=0 only if all eligible rows are 0
published_response_semantics.missing_rule: missing presence/year/site_id is ineligible; no imputation

predeclared_temporal_partition.reason: fixed from independently published APBP historical coverage before response access

prediction_design.selector: promote Layer B iff augmented inner-validation macro log loss is strictly lower than baseline; otherwise baseline-only
prediction_design.layer_b: source-symmetric sequential contextual innovation representation using only eligible ADPE positives strictly before the scored year

qualification_order: Stage0 may open only the immutable sites blob and must verify >=50 unique valid site coordinates and four positive strictly increasing distance-world thresholds.
After Stage0, final response/model contract must be committed before penguin_obs payload access.
The response blob may then be opened exactly once; schema/estimability failure or a scored result is terminal.

stop_rules.stage0_transport_schema_or_geometry_fail: terminal pre-response STOP; no repair within this attempt
stop_rules.response_schema_or_estimability_failure: terminal consumed STOP; no parser, target, partition or threshold repair
stop_rules.scored_result: favorable, protective-null, conservative-miss or adverse are all terminal
